name: singlet_velocity_latent_time_inference
title: Latent time from splicing kinetics
description: Estimates a per-cell latent time, a shared scalar clock that orders cells along a splicing-kinetic process, from spliced and unspliced counts and a required root cell. Writes obs/latent_time, a method-specific copy, a confidence column and gene-wise fitted times. Use after kinetic fitting and root identification; do not use without a defined start state, and do not read the values as absolute time because the scale is a convention.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: velovae is the model-based default; scvelo_dynamical is the published heuristic standard and the fallback.

root.description: obs column with one TRUE start cell, or a cell identifier. Required: the tool never infers a root.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Random seed for initialisation and minibatch order in the deep methods.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

scvelo.description: Options for scvelo_dynamical; ignored by other methods.

min_likelihood.description: Minimum gene fit likelihood for genes entering the shared-time step; null keeps all fitted genes.

min_confidence.description: Cells with confidence below this are replaced by neighbour sums during smoothing.

t_max.description: Overall duration that multiplies the [0,1] latent time; null keeps the [0,1] scale.

weight_diffusion.description: Weight w blending latent time with velocity pseudotime: (1 - w) latent + w pseudotime.

min_corr_diffusion.description: Keep genes whose fitted time correlates with velocity pseudotime at or above this value.

recover_max_iter.description: Maximum EM iterations in the dynamical-model fit.

fit_time.description: Fit switch times in the dynamical model.

fit_scaling.description: Fit unspliced and spliced scaling in the dynamical model.

fit_steady_states.description: Fit steady-state parameters in the dynamical model.

unitvelo.description: Options for unitvelo; ignored by other methods.

fit_option.description: '1' selects unified-time mode; '2' selects independent mode.

base_function.description: Base transcription function; Gaussian is the only form ported.

velovae.description: Options for velovae; ignored by other methods.

std_prior.description: Standard deviation of the gene-mode Dirichlet prior.

n_epochs.description: Training epochs; null uses the implementation default.

velovi.description: Options for velovi; ignored by other methods.

time_statistic.description: mean: expected time over the state distribution; max: time of the most probable state.

n_samples.description: Posterior samples used for the latent-time summary.

velocity_pseudotime.description: Options for velocity_pseudotime; ignored by other methods.

n_dcs.description: Diffusion components used for the pseudotime.

use_velocity_graph.description: Diffuse on the velocity graph (true) or on a similarity kernel (false).

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. obs/latent_time. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary: method, root, coverage, time_scale (minmax or t_max) and n_genes_used. Never per-cell arrays.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
